AutomaticMachineTimePerPatient.definition: Time taken by the automatic machine to process one patient.

ManualMachineTimePerPatient.definition: Time taken by the manual machine to process one patient.

ManualPatientMinRatio.definition: Minimum ratio of manual machine patients to automatic machine patients.

AutomaticMachineMinimumPatients.definition: Minimum number of patients that must be processed by the automatic machine.

TotalAvailableTime.definition: Total available time for the clinic in minutes.
